_meta.method_note: Volunteer-run OONI Probe measurements of NEWS-category sites over a trailing 28-day window. confirmed = fingerprint-matched blocking (the strong signal); anomalies are consistent-with-blocking but weaker and are never headlined. Measurement volume follows volunteer presence, NOT censorship: a country with no measurements is unknown, never clean. No rates or percentages are derived — counts only, with the measurement total always alongside.
